name: Together AI pricing - GPU Clusters
notes: GPU Clusters section, explicitly 'All prices per gpu per hour'. On-demand pay-as-you-go: NVIDIA HGX H100 $5.49; HGX B200 $8.99. H200, B300, GB200 NVL72 and GB300 NVL72 are all 'Contact us' on-demand. Every Reserved tier is 'Contact sales' (/monthly-reserved). So Together publishes exactly one number, $5.49/H100-hr, and gates everything else behind sales. Announced on-demand B200s on GPU Clusters. Their per-token serverless prices on the same page are a different unit and are NOT recorded as supply.
